name: ParaBank: Open New Savings Account
description: Logs into ParaBank online banking with vault credentials (PARABANK_USERNAME / PARABANK_PASSWORD), opens a new SAVINGS account funded from the customer's first existing account (the pre-selected default, since the funding list is customer-specific), and returns the new account number from the "Account Opened!" confirmation page as output `newAccountNumber`. The account-opening submission is marked irreversible and requires human approval on every replay. Business outcomes: LOGIN_REJECTED (credentials not verified — terminal, no account opened).

newAccountNumber.description: The account number of the newly opened SAVINGS account, from the confirmation page.
